name: Mahou Shoujo Satsuki-chan
original_name: 魔法少女さつきちゃん
source:
Igawa Satsuki is a girl chosen to be a future witch.
She fights against criminals and monsters to apprehend them all, but ending up in the hands of monsters.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ017709.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
